jobs.description:
Are you the new forklift hero of Bavaria?
At Bavaria, we are looking for enthusiastic forklift drivers to join our logistics team. In this full-time role, you play a key part in ensuring that our logistics processes run smoothly every day. Do you want to work for one of the world’s most iconic beer brands in a dynamic and team-oriented environment? Then keep reading!

What will you do?
As a forklift driver, you play an essential role in our warehouse operations. You ensure that pallets filled with our beverages are placed in the right location in a safe and structured way. Once production is completed, you take over and carefully move goods throughout the warehouse.
You will also support export activities, making sure our products are prepared correctly and reach international customers safely and on time.

Your daily tasks

- Using an on-board computer, you know exactly which pallets need to be moved and where they should go.
- You prepare goods for shipment to customers around the world.
- You work closely with your colleagues and always maintain a safe working environment.
- You get the chance to learn different areas of the warehouse, with the order pool as your fixed base.

Working hours & flexibility
At Bavaria, we work with both day shifts and a 3-shift system. Flexibility is important:

Day shifts

- 08:00 – 16:30
- 09:30 – 18:00

3-shift system

- Early shift: 06:00 – 14:00
- Late shift: 14:00 – 22:00
- Night shift: 22:00 – 06:00 (always in blocks of 4 nights)

This way, we offer a varied but structured work schedule where your contribution truly makes a difference.

*This is a temporary position lasting approximately till April 2027.

- You are in possession of a valid forklift certificate;
- You are fluent in either Dutch or English;
- You are willing to work in shift patterns, including day shifts.

Are you a hard worker who feels at home in a dynamic logistics environment? For our client in Son & Breugel, we are looking for a Logistics Employee who is ready to roll up their sleeves. In this role, you will work together with an enthusiastic team and help ensure that the logistics process runs smoothly. The work is divided across different teams: Crossdock (incoming and outgoing goods), Packing (reach truck) and Pick & Pack (order picking).

What will you do?

As a Warehouse Employee, you will be responsible for various tasks within the warehouse. You will ensure that orders are processed correctly and that the logistics process runs efficiently.

Your tasks will include:

- Picking orders
- Packing and preparing orders for shipment
- Checking shipments for accuracy and completeness
- Loading and unloading goods
- Re-stacking and processing incoming goods
- Working with an EPT and reach truck
- Maintaining a safe and clean working environment

You will work day shifts, with working hours from 08:00 to 17:00.

- You already have some experience in logistics
- You are in possession of an EPT certificate and know how to work with it properly
- You have a valid reach truck certificate
- You are proactive, hands-on and work accurately
- You speak and understand both English well

Are you a s​tudent looking for a flexible part-time job alongside your studies?
Would you like to make some money, stay active and work in a friendly international team? Then this part-time position at DHL Supply Chain in Weert could be perfect for you!

As a Warehouse Employee, you will help keep the warehouse running smoothly. 

Your tasks include:

- Receiving and checking incoming goods
- Picking and packing customer orders
- Scanning products with a hand scanner
- Registering products in the warehouse system
- Checking products for damage or mistakes
- Reporting problems to your Team Leader
- Helping colleagues when needed
- Keeping your workplace clean, organised and safe

We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated s​tudents who are not afraid to get to work.

You have:

- A positive and motivated attitude
- Basic logistics knowledge is a plus
- Basic computer skills
- Basic English skills (A/B)
- Good attention to detail
- Experience with a hand scanner is a plus
- Certificates are a plus, but not required
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team

Are you looking for an active job in logistics?

As a Logistics Associate at DHL, you will work together with your colleagues to ensure a smooth sorting process. You will process packages so they can be delivered to customers on time.

Your responsibilities include placing packages on the sorting conveyor belt, processing sorted shipments, and supporting the daily logistics operation. You will work Monday to Friday and be available 3 to 5 days per week. Shifts start around 5:00 PM and end around 2:45 AM. Start and end times may vary.

Packages can weigh up to 25 kg. If a package is heavier or difficult to lift, you will always lift it together with a colleague.

- You are available for at least 3 to 4 days per week
- You are at least 18 years old
- You speak Dutch or English
- You live in or around Zwolle, Meppel or Kampen
- You have your own transportation (car, bicycle or scooter) or live within walking distance of the sorting center

jobs.occupation: Warehouse Team Leader Inbound in 2-shifts in Venlo
jobs.description:
Ready to take charge in a high-tech logistics hub and make a real impact every day? Start your career at one of the largest logistics companies in Venlo. Read on and apply now! Wat zijn de werkzaamheden?
ProfCore is partnering with a leading international logistics provider in the Venlo region to recruit motivated Inbound Team Leaders. You’ll be hired directly by the employer, an established name in the logistics industry. You are working in a modern, largely automated environment. In this role, you’ll be the vital link between people and processes. You’ll ensure that daily inbound operations—from receiving to processing goods—run smoothly and efficiently. Supported by advanced technology and data insights, you’ll guide your team toward optimal performance. You’ll be part of a international team where collaboration, commitment, and collegiality are at the basic of everything we do. What you can expect:
- You’ll coordinate daily tasks and serve as the first point of contact for a team of 15 to 30 warehouse operators.
- You’ll identify bottlenecks and proactively resolve workflow issues to keep operations running smoothly.
- You’ll monitor and optimize the flow of goods within your department, ensuring efficiency and accuracy.
- You’ll collaborate with colleagues to continuously improve processes and drive performance.
- You’ll track key performance indicators (KPIs) closely and make adjustments where needed to meet targets.

- You have concrete managerial experience in a logistics environment.
- You have a good command of the English language, both spoken and written.
- You have excellent communication skills and know how to convey your passion to others.
- You have knowledge of logistics processes within a warehouse, preferably 3PL logistics.
- You feel at home in an environment where courage, personal growth and taking action are central.

Salary €14.99 per hour + opportunity for a pay increase after 26 worked weeks

Are you looking for an active job where you can start right away? Do you enjoy hands-on work and being part of a friendly team? Then this Production Employee position in Tiel could be perfect for you!

What will you do?

As a Production Employee, you and your colleagues ensure that hospital clothing and other textiles are cleaned, sorted, and prepared for use on time. You will work in a modern production environment where the pace is high and no two days are the same.

Your tasks include:

- Sorting incoming laundry
- Operating washing and production machines
- Checking the quality of cleaned textiles
- Preparing clothing and linen for shipment
- Working together with colleagues to meet daily production targets

You will work in different shifts:

- Early shift: 06:00 AM - 11:00 AM
- Day shift: 11:00 AM - 04:00 PM
- Extended day shift: 06:00 AM - 04:00 PM

Do you prefer one of these shifts? Let's discuss the possibilities!

- You have an MBO-level (vocational) working and thinking ability
- No previous work experience is required
- You speak Dutch or English
- You are flexible and available to work different shifts
- You work accurately and can keep up with a fast pace
- You live within approximately 20 kilometers of Tiel

As a logistics employee, you handle incoming and outgoing goods every day. You unpack and check products, and prepare them for shipment. You also ensure the warehouse remains tidy and organized. You work with scanners and sometimes a forklift. Working hours are flexible, and you can work either full-time or part-time. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that customers receive their orders on time.

You are someone who likes to roll up their sleeves and enjoys working as part of a team. You value completing tasks neatly and on time. You are capable of working accurately and have no trouble standing or walking during your shift. You have a reasonable command of spoken and written English, enabling effective communication within the team. Logistics experience is a plus but not a requirement—you are a quick learner! You live within 20 kilometers of Lelystad.

Mandatory requirements:

- You have at least a VMBO level of education/aptitude
- You speak and write English
- You live within 20 km of Lelystad

jobs.occupation: Production Worker Food Production  Gouda  36 hours (111315001)
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a production job in Gouda? As a Production Worker, you help keep the production process running smoothly. Together with your team, you work on cutting, packing, filling and labeling food products. You start with a salary from €14.71 per hour, work 36 hours per week, and there is free parking available at the location.

This is a practical job where you see the results of your work immediately.

At the start of your shift, you check the production line with your team. Once everything is ready, the production process begins. You help keep the line running and make sure products are processed correctly. Together with your colleagues, you make sure everything runs smoothly.

Your tasks include:

- Working on a production line with about 5 colleagues
- Cutting, filling, packing and labeling food products
- Keeping the workplace clean and organized
- Performing quality checks during production
- Reporting small issues or deviations to the operator

You play an important role in the production process.

Working in a production environment requires teamwork, accuracy and a practical mindset. This role suits someone who enjoys hands-on work and working together with colleagues.

Requirements:

- MBO working and thinking level
- English and/or Dutch language skills
- Accurate and motivated work attitude

Preferred:

- Experience in production or factory work
- Ability to work in a busy production environment
- Attention to safety and hygiene

Are you looking for a job to combine with your studies or family life? Then we have a great opportunity for you! For our warehouse in Ede, we are looking for an order picker and packer for the morning and afternoon shifts. You start your workday by receiving and checking incoming goods. Next, you make sure that products are stored in the correct location in the warehouse. Using modern systems such as hand scanners and voice picking, you collect orders. You check if everything is correct and prepare the orders for shipment. During your work, you are constantly on the move and actively contribute to a smooth logistics process!

You work in a 2-shift system:

These two shifts alternate weekly. Additionally, you work one Saturday every four weeks.

- You can speak English or Dutch

- Resident of the NetherlandsValid
